status: Bounded scratch implementation prepared under root approval; no engine parse, native appearance or Game adoption yet
reason: Current ship.gd sets environment.reflected_light_source=REFLECTION_SOURCE_DISABLED. The existing opaque privacy profile therefore has direct highlights but cannot yet reflect the actual court.
scope: One local actual-court reflection capture, applied only to residential exterior panes. No change to public/shower/rail glass, global sky, world ambient or eight-light budget.

parameters.receiver_layer: One verified unused visual layer assigned only to exterior privacy child meshes; keep their original camera-visible layer as well
parameters.cull_mask: Only the exact public court subtree and three opaque exterior coating meshes; private shells/furniture/lights/diagnostic targets excluded
parameters.capture_trigger: Once after player remains near the actual court0.5s and normal LightingBudget refreshes; manual review refresh only, never UPDATE_ALWAYS

capture_order: Wait for the actual connected scene and normal LightingBudget selection to settle at the review location.
Capture the actual authored geometry once over the documented six frames. Do not substitute a generic cubemap or sky.
Freeze updates during diagnostic unshielded controls, then restore private geometry and refresh once before natural captures.
Re-run relevant exterior privacy comparisons with reflections enabled, including oblique views and bright rooms.
limits: A box-projected static probe is an approximation, not ray-traced planar mirrors.
Two probes per mesh is the documented Compatibility limit; this court uses at most one.
Judge the current clear interior view and genuinely missing planting first; do not use this as a reason to enlarge the quiet court.
